visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with green-tinted hair and a grey mesh top faces the camera, holding a pale blue rectangular box with gold lettering. Behind her is a white wall and a vintage gold clock. (2) The camera zooms in as she opens the box, revealing two glass perfume bottles and a larger white plastic bottle nestled in a light blue velvet lining. (3) She holds the box close to her face, gesturing with her right hand while speaking. Text overlays and digital icons appear on the screen. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the base of a small amber-colored glass bottle, specifically highlighting the gold label and fine printed text. (5) She unscrews the gold cap of a perfume bottle, bringing it to her nose to smell. Her eyes widen in a shocked expression. (6) A split screen shows the woman on the bottom and a CGI background of a cozy indoor fireplace with a stone wall and rain outside on the top. (7) She compares the vintage bottle to an image of a modern red perfume bottle overlaying the screen. (8) She applies a dark liquid from a small bottle onto her wrist, rubbing it in while looking closely at the texture. (9) She picks up the white plastic bottle, turning it around to show the back label which has small dark spots indicating mold. (10) She opens the white bottle and smells it, smiling and gesturing excitedly toward the camera. (11) The woman holds the entire open gift set once more, smiling brightly with her hands framing the box.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long, straight hair tinted green, wearing a grey mesh/knit top and silver jewelry.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Primary background is a plain white wall with a vintage-style gold alarm clock on a wooden surface. Secondary background is a CGI fireplace scene used as a visual metaphor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sequence begins with an upbeat, rhythmic electronic track and clear, high-pitched female Mandarin speech. The tempo is approximately 128 BPM. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the reveal of the box's contents, followed by a slight swell in the music's volume. (3) A series of 'whoosh' sounds accompany rapid visual transitions and the appearance of text graphics on the screen. (4) A loud, gasping intake of breath and an 'Oh My God' exclamation mark the olfactory reaction, where vocal arousal spikes to a high level. (5) Soft crackling sound effects, simulating a fireplace, are layered over the music during the split-screen metaphorical segment. (6) The vocal tone shifts to a more descriptive, informative, yet still excited register as she details the history of the product. (7) Final segment features a bright, positive bell SFX as the speaker concludes her review, with the music fading slightly as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Deep Dive -> Sensory Reaction -> Final Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase a rare, 55-year-old vintage Estée Lauder beauty gift set. The creator unboxes the items, researches their origin via on-bottle codes, and performs a sensory test (smelling and skin application) to provide a unique historical review, emphasizing the set's value as a collectible.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcase of brand heritage, positive emotional reaction to product quality even after 50 years, and explicit mention of the brand's current popularity.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses sensory metaphors (the fireplace visual) to convey scent, which is a highly effective multimodal storytelling technique.
